reason: A browser-side search utility for finding, highlighting, and navigating text within the currently rendered conversation, including content that changes during streaming.

summaries.zh: 在当前对话中提供支持大小写和整词匹配的文本搜索、结果高亮及跳转导航。
summaries.en: Provides in-conversation text search with case and whole-word matching, result highlighting, and navigation through the active transcript.

capabilities: Reads rendered transcript text in the active conversation
Provides in-conversation text matching, highlighting, and navigation
Observes transcript DOM mutations to update search results during streaming
Adds a floating search bar and conversation header action to the web UI
